personal.name: Manav Mate

positioning.persona: Execution-focused Event Operations Manager and Founder with 4+ years of hands-on experience delivering 150 to 200+ events in partnership with 15+ premier event management companies across Mumbai. Proven expertise spanning Corporate MICE, Governmental Summits, Live Concerts, Sporting Marathons, and Luxury Weddings at Jio World Convention Centre, NESCO, Mumbai University, and Sahara Star. Directed end-to-end venue mapping, custom merchandise and event procurement, technical AV time management, catering setup planning, and on-ground workforce deployments of up to 133 personnel with a 100% SLA record. Certified International Project Manager (CIPM) from PMI and certified in Operations Management from Saylor University, combining calm on-site crisis handling with Canva pitch design and AI-driven planning workflows.
positioning.years_experience: 4+ years in event operations, MICE project management, and production logistics (150-200+ events across 15+ agencies)
